storyCards.headline: Simple Man: The Personal Story Behind the Song
storyCards.fact:
Lynyrd Skynyrd's "Simple Man" — original release 1973. "Simple Man" is a song by American rock band Lynyrd Skynyrd, released on their debut studio album, (Pronounced 'Lĕh-'nérd 'Skin-'nérd) (1973).

Since the song became available for digital download, it has become Lynyrd Skynyrd's third best-selling digital song after "Sweet Home Alabama" and "Free Bird." It has sold 1,333,000 copies in the U.S.

Simple Man was released in 1973.

Album: Lynyrd Skynyrd (pronounced leh-nerd skin-nerd) (1973).
